// Writes Hive 2.2.3 boxes as older Sushi Tracker versions stored them.
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:hive/hive.dart';

class LegacySession {
  LegacySession(this.id, this.startedAt, this.endedAt, this.count, this.duration, [this.epoch]);
  final String id; final DateTime startedAt; final DateTime endedAt;
  final int count; final int duration; final int? epoch;
}

class SessionAdapter extends TypeAdapter<LegacySession> {
  SessionAdapter(this.withEpoch);
  final bool withEpoch;
  @override final int typeId = 0;
  @override LegacySession read(BinaryReader r) => throw UnimplementedError();
  @override void write(BinaryWriter w, LegacySession o) {
    w..writeByte(withEpoch ? 6 : 5)
     ..writeByte(0)..write(o.id)..writeByte(1)..write(o.startedAt)
     ..writeByte(2)..write(o.endedAt)..writeByte(3)..write(o.count)
     ..writeByte(4)..write(o.duration);
    if (withEpoch) w..writeByte(5)..write(o.epoch ?? 0);
  }
}

class LegacyGlobal { LegacyGlobal(this.taps, this.sessions, [this.epoch]); final int taps, sessions; final int? epoch; }

class GlobalAdapter extends TypeAdapter<LegacyGlobal> {
  GlobalAdapter(this.withEpoch);
  final bool withEpoch;
  @override final int typeId = 1;
  @override LegacyGlobal read(BinaryReader r) => throw UnimplementedError();
  @override void write(BinaryWriter w, LegacyGlobal o) {
    w..writeByte(withEpoch ? 3 : 2)..writeByte(0)..write(o.taps)..writeByte(1)..write(o.sessions);
    if (withEpoch) w..writeByte(2)..write(o.epoch ?? 0);
  }
}

Future<void> write(String dir, {required bool modern}) async {
  Directory(dir).createSync(recursive: true);
  Hive.init(dir);
  Hive.registerAdapter(SessionAdapter(modern), override: true);
  Hive.registerAdapter(GlobalAdapter(modern), override: true);
  final sessions = await Hive.openBox<LegacySession>('sessions');
  final global = await Hive.openBox<LegacyGlobal>('global_state');
  final app = await Hive.openBox('app_state');
  final t = DateTime.utc(2026, 3, 14, 20);
  await sessions.put('s1', LegacySession('s1', t, t.add(const Duration(minutes: 40)), 12, 2400, modern ? 0 : null));
  await sessions.put('s2', LegacySession('s2', t.add(const Duration(days: 7)), t.add(const Duration(days: 7, minutes: 55)), 18, 3300, modern ? 0 : null));
  await global.put('state', LegacyGlobal(30, 2, modern ? 0 : null));
  if (modern) {
    await app.put('ongoing_session', {'count': 4, 'startedAt': t.add(const Duration(days: 30)).millisecondsSinceEpoch});
    await app.put('epoch_migration_v1', true);
    await app.put('keep_screen_on', false);
  } else {
    await app.put('ongoingCount', 4);
    await app.put('ongoingStartedAt', t.add(const Duration(days: 30)));
  }
  await Hive.close();
}

Future<void> main(List<String> args) async {
  await write('${args[0]}/legacy_v01', modern: false);
  await write('${args[0]}/v03', modern: true);
}
